[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书
空中大冒险
美国尼克儿童频道／著
安东尼／译
天地出版社｜TIANDI PRESS

[P2] 一天傍晚，天天开心地在空中旋转、爬升、俯冲，因为她的偶像——特技飞行员爱丝将要来冒险湾参加一场特技飞行表演。
“特技飞行感觉太棒啦！”她兴奋得大喊道。
可是，在草地上玩耍的毛毛却并不这么认为，能飞的东西中他只要风筝。

[P3] 突然，一阵狂风吹来，把毛毛和风筝一起刮上了天空。毛毛被风筝线给缠住了，只见他摔向地面，正好砸在了灰灰的身上。
毛毛咧嘴一笑：“对不起！我想我的着陆技术还有待提高！”
这时，莱德的平板电脑接到了一通求助电话——来自特技飞行员爱丝。爱丝的飞机引擎出现了故障，急需汪汪队来帮她找到一个合适的着陆点。
莱德大声说：“汪汪队马上到！没有困难的工作，只有勇敢的狗狗！”

[P4] 莱德迅速召集狗狗们来到塔台，把情况告诉了大家，他需要用到天天的直升机和夜视风镜。
“狗狗要飞上天啦！”天天叫道，她迫切地想去帮助她的英雄。
莱德还需要阿奇用聚光灯和交通锥在农夫由美的农场中准备出一条跑道。
“保证完成任务！”英姿飒爽的德国牧羊犬热切地喊道。
最后，莱德让灰灰来负责修理爱丝的飞机。
“旧物别丢掉，还有大用处！我一定能修好飞机！”灰灰欢呼着。

[P5] 伴随着直升机穿越云层的轰鸣声，太阳渐渐落下去了。天天通过她的夜视风镜在夜空中仔细地搜寻着，终于发现了在不远处的爱丝。
爱丝的飞机正在飞越山峰，飞机上不时有碎片掉落在树梢上。引擎冒出的黑烟越来越浓，这严重影响了爱丝的视线。
天天加速飞到了爱丝飞机的前方。“跟上我！”她喊道，随即带领爱丝一同飞向了农夫由美的农场。

[P6] 这时，莱德、阿奇和灰灰正在农场准备飞机的备降跑道。
阿奇用他的橘色交通锥摆出了一块跑道区域。

“干得漂亮！”莱德称赞道。
天越来越黑了，莱德问灰灰能否从他的回收库中找出一些旧探照灯来。
“我刚好有一捆！”灰灰答道，然后他迅速取来探照灯，和莱德一起把这些
灯与锥筒绑在了一起。
当他们准备完毕后，莱德呼叫天天，告诉她注意查看跑道上的灯筒。
“收到指令！”天天回答。

[P7] 天天驾驶着直升机穿行在星空下，她刚翻过小山就看到了那条醒目的光束带。她和爱丝准备降落的时候，突然听到一声巨响。爱丝的飞机开始剧烈摇晃，机翼上不时有火花冒出。爱丝通过无线电告诉大家，她必须马上跳伞。

莱德认为在黑夜中跳伞太危险了，于是他想到了另一个办法。“爱丝，你曾经做过机翼上行走的特技吗？”他问道。

“爱丝可是世界上最好的机翼漫步者呢！”天天说道。

“太好了！”莱德欢呼起来。他命天天降下牵引绳和安全带。

[P8] 爱丝解开座椅上的安全带，
小心翼翼地从驾驶舱爬上了不停
晃动着的机翼。天天从上降下
牵引绳和安全带，慢慢地向爱丝
靠近。爱丝试图抓住安全带，可
是扑了空！

“我还是用降落伞吧！”爱
丝有些着急，“我准备跳了！”

天天叫道：“不！我们一定能做到的，爱丝！”

天天把直升机降得更低、更靠近爱丝了。爱丝再次做了尝试，
这一次她终于抓住了安全带！爱丝扣紧安全带，双手抓牢牵引绳，
一直往农夫由美的农场飞去。

[P9] 当天天抵达农场的时候，爱丝通过无线电呼叫莱德，希望他帮忙追踪到“艾美利亚”。
“没问题！但是，谁是艾美利亚？”莱德问。
“我的飞机呀！每个特技飞行员都会给自己的飞机起个名字。”爱丝答道。
莱德立即用平板电脑追踪飞机，发现它正往海湾水域坠去。
“我们必须在它坠入海里之前找到它！”莱德说。
莱德和阿奇迅速赶往海湾，天天则缓缓地把爱丝降落到农场上。爱丝解开安全带，朝着直升机挥舞双手。“谢谢你，天天！”她喊道。
“别客气，爱丝！”天天回答道。她兴奋地对自己说：
“真不敢相信，我竟然救了自己心目中的大英雄！”，

[P10] “砰！”艾美利亚掉了下来，它在海面上滑行了一段距离后终于停了下来。莱德驾驶着他的沙滩车飞速驶向飞机，并快速用一根缆绳拴住了艾美利亚。接着，阿奇开着他的警车使劲儿把飞机往岸边拽。

但是，当爱丝看到自己的飞机时，她已经对参加特技飞行表演不抱任何希望了——飞机已经严重损坏，只有专业团队才能修好它。

不过，不是还有汪汪队吗？

“随时待命！”灰灰说。

[P11] “我已经等不及要观看明天的特技飞行表演了。”天天兴奋地说。
爱丝跳上一侧的机翼，说：“你想近距离观看我的花式机翼行走加翻滚表演吗？”
天天觉得这太不可思议了！

借着阿奇的聚光灯的光亮，灰灰用铆钉修补飞机的机翼。莱德在修理驾驶座椅，爱丝则在调试引擎。不一会儿，天天试着启动飞机，只见螺旋桨开始旋转起来，引擎也发出了嗡嗡声，飞机又跟新的一样了！

[P12] 第二天，阳光明媚，汪汪队的队员们很早就来到了冒险湾的沙滩上，迫不及待地想要观看爱丝的特技飞行表演。当艾美利亚出现在天空时，狗狗们都挥舞着双手大声欢呼起来。在飞机的机身变得平稳后，爱丝从驾驶舱里爬出，然后站在了机翼上。此时，天天正微笑着坐在操控台后面呢。

突然，爱丝跳向了空中，而天天则驾驶着飞机翻滚了一圈。当机身再次回正时，爱丝平稳地落在了机翼上。莱德和狗狗们都惊呆了，这一切对他们来说简直太不可思议了，这个花式机翼行走加翻滚表演真是让人惊叹不已啊！

[P13] “哇哦！她太棒了！”灰灰看到天天驾驶着
飞机穿过云层，不由得赞叹道。
“你们都很棒！”莱德说。
狗狗们都欢呼起来。爱丝和天天则在空中俯
冲拉升，好像是在和他们一起庆祝呢。
full_text_en:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
Paw Patrol: Children's Safety Rescue Storybook
Great Adventure in the Sky
By Nickelodeon Children's Channel
Translated by Anthony
Tiandi Press | TIANDI PRESS

[P2] One evening,天天 happily spun, climbed, and dove in the air, because her idol—stunt pilot Skye—was coming to Adventure Bay for a stunt flying show.
"Stunt flying feels amazing!" she shouted excitedly.
However, Marshall, who was playing on the grass, didn't think so. Among things that can fly, he only wanted kites.

[P3] Suddenly, a strong wind blew, carrying Rocky and his kite into the sky. Rocky got tangled in the kite string and fell toward the ground, landing right on top of Grey.
Rocky grinned and said, “Sorry! I guess my landing skills still need some improvement!”
At that moment, Ryder’s tablet received an emergency call—from stunt pilot Everest. Everest’s plane engine had malfunctioned, and she urgently needed the Paw Patrol to help her find a suitable landing spot.
Ryder shouted, “Paw Patrol, to the rescue! No job is too tough, only brave pups!”

[P4] Ryder quickly gathered the pups at the tower and told them the situation. He needed to use Skye's helicopter and night vision goggles.
"The pups are flying up into the sky!" Skye called out, eager to help her hero.
Ryder also needed Chase to use spotlights and traffic cones to prepare a runway in Farmer Yumi's farm.
"Mission accomplished!" the handsome German Shepherd called out enthusiastically.
Finally, Ryder assigned Rocky to repair the plane for Everest.
"Don't throw away old things—they're still useful! I can definitely fix the plane!" Rocky cheered.

[P5] With the roaring sound of the helicopter cutting through the clouds, the sun was slowly setting. Skye, using her night vision goggles, carefully searched the night sky and finally spotted Ace not far away.
Ace's plane was flying over the mountain peaks, with pieces occasionally falling onto the treetops. The engine was emitting thicker and thicker black smoke, severely impairing Ace's vision.
Skye accelerated and flew ahead of Ace's plane. "Follow me!" she shouted, then led Ace toward Farmer Yumi's farm.

[P6] At this moment, Ryder, Chase, and Rocky were preparing a backup runway for the plane at the farm.
Chase used his orange traffic cones to mark out a runway area.

"Well done!" Ryder praised.
As it got darker, Ryder asked Rocky if he could find some old spotlights in his recycling bin.
"I just happen to have a bundle!" Rocky replied, then quickly fetched the spotlights and tied them together with the cones alongside Ryder.
After they finished preparing, Ryder called Skye, telling her to pay attention to the lights on the runway.
"Roger that!" Skye replied.

[P7] Skye was piloting her helicopter through the starry sky. She had just flown over a hill when she spotted the bright beam of light. As she and Ace prepared to land, there was a sudden loud bang. Ace's plane began to shake violently, and sparks flew from its wings. Ace radioed everyone, saying she had to jump out immediately.

Ryder thought jumping out in the dark was too dangerous, so he came up with another idea. "Ace, have you ever done wing-walking stunts?" he asked.

"Ace is the best wing-walker in the world!" Skye said.

"Great!" Ryder cheered. He ordered Skye to lower the tow rope and safety harness.

[P8] Aisun unfastened the safety belt on her seat,
and carefully climbed onto the constantly
swaying wing.天天 lowered the
traction rope and safety belt from above, slowly approaching Aisun.
Aisun tried to grab the safety belt, but
missed it!

"I'll just use my parachute!" Aisun
said anxiously, "I'm ready to jump!"

天天 called out: "No! We can definitely do it, Aisun!"

天天 lowered the helicopter even lower, closer to Aisun. Aisun tried again,
and this time she finally grabbed the safety belt! Aisun fastened the safety belt, held tightly onto the traction rope,
and flew steadily toward Farmer Youmei's farm.

[P9] When天天 arrived at the farm, Ace called Ryder on the radio, asking him to help track down "Amelia".
"No problem! But who is Amelia?" Ryder asked.
"My plane! Every stunt pilot gives their plane a name," Ace replied.
Ryder immediately used his tablet to track the plane and found it heading toward the bay waters.
"We must find it before it crashes into the sea!" Ryder said.
Ryder and Chase quickly headed to the bay, while天天 slowly lowered Ace to the farm. Ace unbuckled her seatbelt and waved at the helicopter. "Thank you,天天!" she shouted.
"You're welcome, Ace!"天天 replied. She excitedly said to herself:
"I can't believe I just rescued my own hero!"

[P10] "Bang!" Amelia crashed down and skidded across the water for a short distance before finally stopping. Ryder drove his beach buggy quickly toward the plane and swiftly tied a rope to Amelia. Then, Chase drove his police car and pulled the plane toward the shore.

But when Ace saw her plane, she had lost all hope of performing her stunt show — the plane was severely damaged and only a professional team could fix it.

But isn't there the Paw Patrol?

"Ready when you are!" said Rocky.

[P11] "I can't wait to watch tomorrow's stunt flight show!" Skye said excitedly.
Ace jumped onto one wing and said, "Do you want to watch my wing-walking and flip performance up close?"
Skye thought that was incredible!

With the light from Chase's spotlight, Rocky used rivets to repair the plane's wing. Ryder was fixing the pilot's seat, while Ace was tuning the engine. Soon, Skye tried starting the plane. The propeller began spinning, the engine made a humming sound, and the plane was as good as new!

[P12] The next day, under bright sunshine, the Paw Patrol team arrived early at Adventure Bay's beach, eagerly waiting to watch Ace's stunt flight performance. When Amelia appeared in the sky, the pups waved their hands and cheered loudly. After the plane stabilized, Ace climbed out of the cockpit and stood on the wing. At that moment,天天 was smiling while sitting behind the control panel.

Suddenly, Ace jumped into the air, and天天 piloted the plane to roll a full circle. When the fuselage returned to normal, Ace landed smoothly back on the wing. Ryder and the pups were stunned—this was simply unbelievable for them! This wing-walking and rolling stunt was truly amazing!

[P13] "Wow! She's amazing!" Gray exclaimed as he saw天天 piloting the airplane through the clouds.
"You're all amazing!" Ryder said.
The pups cheered. Air and Tian were diving and climbing in the air, as if celebrating with them.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》的封面，标题为《空中大冒险》，展示了角色Skye驾驶直升机的插图，标明了作者、译者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页描绘了天天在空中进行特技飞行，兴奋地期待偶像爱丝的到来，而地上的毛毛则对飞行不感兴趣，只喜欢风筝。
[P3] 本页描绘了毛毛被狂风吹上天空后摔在灰灰身上，同时莱德接到特技飞行员爱丝的求助电话，她的飞机引擎故障，需要汪汪队帮忙寻找着陆点。
[P4] 莱德召集汪汪队成员，分配任务以帮助特技飞行员爱丝：天天负责驾驶直升机，阿奇准备跑道，灰灰负责修理飞机。
[P5] 天天驾驶直升机在夜空中搜寻并发现引擎故障的特技飞行员爱丝，她带领爱丝飞向农夫由美的农场以寻找安全着陆点。
[P6] 莱德、阿奇和灰灰在农场准备飞机的备降跑道，阿奇用交通锥标出区域，灰灰取出探照灯与锥筒绑在一起，莱德随后呼叫天天，让她注意跑道上的灯筒。
[P7] 天天在空中发现爱丝的飞机引擎故障，爱丝准备跳伞，但莱德认为太危险，于是决定让爱丝在机翼上行走，天天负责降下牵引绳和安全带进行救援。
[P8] 爱丝因飞机引擎故障，试图从机翼跳伞逃生，但被天天用直升机降下的牵引绳和安全带成功救援，最终抓住安全带，向农夫由美的农场飞去。
[P9] 莱德通过平板电脑追踪爱丝的飞机“艾美利亚”，发现其正坠向海湾，随即与阿奇赶往救援。天天将爱丝安全降落到农场，爱丝向天天道谢，天天为自己救了偶像而感到兴奋。
[P10] 爱丝的飞机艾美利亚坠入海中，莱德和阿奇合力将其拖上岸。爱丝看到飞机严重损坏，对参加飞行表演失去希望，但灰灰表示汪汪队随时待命，准备修理飞机。
[P11] 汪汪队成员和爱丝在农夫由美的农场修理飞机，灰灰修补机翼，莱德修理座椅，爱丝调试引擎，天天成功启动飞机。爱丝邀请天天近距离观看她的特技飞行表演，天天感到非常兴奋和不可思议。
[P12] 第二天，汪汪队在冒险湾沙滩上观看爱丝的特技飞行表演，爱丝在机翼上行走并完成翻滚动作，天天驾驶飞机配合，莱德和队员们对此感到惊叹不已。
[P13] 汪汪队成员在沙滩上观看爱丝和天天的飞行表演，对他们的精彩表现感到惊叹，爱丝和天天在空中俯冲拉升，仿佛在与大家一同庆祝。
